findings.title: Explore loads matched banks
findings.expected: At least one bank row after Compare
findings.actual: 10 visible rows; meta=""
findings.userImpact: Without matches the rest of Apply cannot be tested.

findings.title: Public / Private filters change the list
findings.expected: Both Public-only and Private-only lists have banks
findings.actual: Public-only=10; Private-only=10
findings.userImpact: Baseline for selection durability tests.

findings.title: Selected bank stays visible after opposite bank-type filter
findings.expected: Selected "Bank of Maharashtra" remains visible (pinned) when filter is Private-only
findings.actual: Still visible among selected: Bank of Maharashtra
findings.userImpact: User thinks they still have that bank selected for compare/apply, but it disappears from the list.

findings.title: Selected out-of-filter banks are pinned to the top
findings.expected: Selected banks that fail the current filter still appear at top for compare
findings.actual: Selected bank is at top
findings.userImpact: Cannot compare earlier pick vs new private banks side by side.

findings.title: Apply once navigates with a non-empty packet
findings.expected: Land on apply.html with banks in session packet
findings.actual: URL ok; banks=2; names=[Bank of Maharashtra; Axis Bank]
findings.userImpact: Broken handoff means Apply cannot start.

findings.title: Apply packet includes earlier public selection after Private filter
findings.expected: Packet includes "Bank of Maharashtra" plus later private pick
findings.actual: Includes public. Banks: Bank of Maharashtra; Axis Bank
findings.userImpact: Customer applies only to the last filtered set; earlier choice is silently dropped before Firebase.

findings.title: Apply button count matches banks that actually apply
findings.expected: Button N === packet.banks.length === meaningful selected set
findings.actual: ariaCount=2; draftIds=2; packetBanks=2
findings.userImpact: User trusts “Apply to N banks” but fewer banks go to Apply/Firebase.

findings.title: Apply review lists same banks as packet
findings.expected: UI bank list matches packet
findings.actual: UI=[Bank of Maharashtra; Axis Bank] packet=[Bank of Maharashtra; Axis Bank]

findings.userImpact: If Verify never unlocks Submit, applications cannot be sent.

findings.title: Submit shows Application received window with Reference ID
findings.expected: Success dialog: Application received + Reference ID
findings.actual: UI="Application received We've got your application for 1 bank. REFERENCE ID 100043 We'll contact you within 48 hours at qa.apply.test@shroffin.example and may call 9876543210. Documents are not needed from you yet. Review t"

evidence.successText: Application received We've got your application for 1 bank. REFERENCE ID 100043 We'll contact you within 48 hours at qa.apply.test@shroffin.example and may call 9876543210. Documents are not needed from you yet. Review the Documents (opens in a new tab) list if you want to prepare ahead. Missed a detail? Chat now↗ (opens in a new window) or call 91123 34367 Got it

findings.userImpact: This is the customer’s confirmation that we received the application.

findings.title: Firestore write receives contact + banks + status=received
findings.expected: One applications write with name, phone, emails, uid, banks[], status received
findings.actual: collection=applications; id=100043; status=received; banks=1; name=QA Apply Tester; email=qa.apply.test@shroffin.example
findings.userImpact: If this write is wrong/empty, the team never truly receives the application.

findings.title: Apply packet cleared after successful submit
findings.expected: session apply packet removed so refresh cannot double-submit same draft
findings.actual: Packet cleared
findings.userImpact: Stale packet after success risks confusing re-submit UX.

findings.title: Written bank records keep comparison fields (scheme/rate/facility)
findings.expected: scheme / rateType / facility (or offer) present on written banks
findings.actual: bank keys=[id, bankName, bankKey, scheme, rateType, facilityLabel, effectiveRoiPct, loanAmount, tenureLabel, emi]
findings.userImpact: Ops calling the customer cannot see which offer was compared.

findings.title: Written application keeps customer input numbers
findings.expected: monthlyIncome 250000 (or form equivalent) in written payload
findings.actual: query.monthlyIncome=250000; form.monthlyIncome=2,50,000; age=42; cibil=810
findings.userImpact: Wrong saved inputs → wrong bank conversation.
